_comment: PLAN.md D1-D4, D8; CLASS-CONTENT.md section 1 (defaults set 2026-10-26 09:20, owner questions Q53-Q55; TUNE).
The source of truth for the class table and the lineage: tools/build-classes.py copies it into
data/SKSE/Plugins/NjordlingerCombatGameplayOverhaul/ with each record's form IDs from the plugin build.
Names and descriptions are the English text; the page shows NJ_ClassName_<id> / NJ_ClassDesc_<id> when translated.
tier: 0 Novice (the three starts), 1 Apprentice, 2 Adept. Expert, Master and Legendary are rank-perk pairs A/B
(config/class-content.json) with no new class name; Legendary is a title instead when the character has earned one
groups: the skill groups the class holds; a hybrid's second group opens when it is chosen and never closes again.
extraSkills: single skills held outside the groups; they are inherited along the lineage (an Archer's Archery stays
with the Scout or Witchhunter it becomes, and with nothing else).
next: the two options at the next upgrade. A class reachable from two parents is one record.

classes.name: Warrior
classes.description: A fighter of steel and shield. Holds the warrior skills and smithing. Health regenerates 50% faster.

classes.name: Mage
classes.description: A student of the five schools. Holds the magic skills and enchanting. Magicka regenerates 50% faster.

classes.name: Thief
classes.description: Quick hands and a quiet step. Holds the covert skills and alchemy. You move 20% faster while sneaking.

classes.name: Knight
classes.description: Armour and discipline. You take 10% less damage from weapons and spells.

classes.name: Barbarian
classes.description: Raw strength. Power attacks deal 25% more damage to staggered or fleeing enemies.

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.description: Raw arcane power. A 10% chance to absorb the magicka of an incoming spell.

classes.name: Healer
classes.description: The restoring hand. Restoration spells cost 20% less when dual cast.

classes.name: Assassin
classes.description: Death from the shadows. Sneak attacks deal 25% more damage.

classes.name: Archer
classes.description: The patient bow. Keeps Archery. You move 20% faster while a bow is drawn.

classes.name: Crusader
classes.description: Steel and faith. Opens the magic skills. Blocking with a shield resists 50% of arrow and spell damage.

classes.name: Spellsword
classes.description: Blade and spell in one hand each. Opens the magic skills. Destruction costs 20% less while a weapon is equipped.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: A blade with no code. Opens the covert skills. Power attacks with an empty off hand deal 25% more; dual-wield power attacks cost 20% less stamina.

classes.name: Scout
classes.description: Far ahead of the column. Holds the warrior and covert skills. Stamina regenerates 50% faster.

classes.name: Battlemage
classes.description: Spell and steel together. Opens the warrior skills. A held ward absorbs 50% of incoming weapon damage.

classes.name: Nightblade
classes.description: Shadow and spell. Holds the magic and covert skills. Illusion spells are twice as strong while you sneak.

classes.name: Witchhunter
classes.description: Hunter of the unnatural. Holds the magic and covert skills. Your poisons last 50% more hits.

classes.name: Monk
classes.description: The open hand. Opens the covert skills. +100 armour while unarmed, and unarmed strikes stagger.

classes.name: Agent
classes.description: Words and poison. Opens the magic skills. Your poisons last 50% more hits.

titles.name: Archmage
titles.description: Master of the College of Winterhold. All spells are 10% stronger.

titles.name: Listener
titles.description: The voice of the Night Mother. Dagger sneak attacks deal 50% more.

titles.name: Nightingale
titles.description: Sworn to Nocturnal. You take 10% less damage while sneaking.

titles.name: Dragonborn
titles.description: The one who ended Alduin. Shouts recover 20% faster and dragons take 10% more damage from you.

titles.name: Hero of Old
titles.description: The Ebony Warrior is laid to rest. 10% less damage taken below half health, and your power attacks cannot be staggered.
